resource.name: STG Questionnaire
resource.title: Paediatric Pneumonia, PICU Management, Standard Treatment Guidelines

item.text: Age and weight of the child, and the indication for intensive care
Respiratory support needed (oxygen, high-flow, CPAP, ventilation)
Working diagnosis and the severity scores recorded at admission
Expected length of PICU stay

resource.name: STG Questionnaire
resource.title: Percutaneous Transluminal Coronary Angioplasty (PTCA), Standard Treatment Guidelines

item.text: Presentation: stable angina, unstable angina, NSTEMI or STEMI, with the date of onset
ECG and troponin findings
Coronary angiography findings: vessels involved and degree of stenosis
Left ventricular ejection fraction
Number of stents planned and whether drug-eluting

resource.name: STG Questionnaire
resource.title: Cataract Surgery with Foldable IOL, Standard Treatment Guidelines

item.text: Best corrected visual acuity of the eye to be operated
Type and grade of cataract on slit-lamp examination
Is the other eye already operated, or planned within the same admission?
Intraocular lens planned (monofocal / multifocal) and biometry done?
Duration of pain and the clinical signs (McBurney tenderness, guarding, rebound)
Total leukocyte count and CRP
Ultrasound or CT findings supporting acute appendicitis
Any suspicion of perforation, abscess or mass?

resource.name: STG Questionnaire
resource.title: Total Knee Replacement (Unilateral), Standard Treatment Guidelines

item.text: Duration of symptoms and the conservative treatment tried (months of physiotherapy, analgesics, injections)
Kellgren-Lawrence grade of osteoarthritis on the standing X-ray
Range of motion and deformity of the knee (flexion contracture, varus/valgus)
Is this a revision of an earlier arthroplasty?
Fitness for surgery: comorbidities and the anaesthetic assessment (ASA grade)
